name: Avites
description: People who lived in modern Gaza

points: The Avims which dwelt in Hazerim, even unto Azzah, the Caphtorims destroyed them and dwelt in their stead; the Most High moves nations in and out of lands as he wills.

note.label: Deuteronomy 2: Meddle Not With Them, and the Giants That Perished

points: This is the land that yet remains: all the borders of the Philistines with their five lords, the Gazathites, the Ashdothites, the Eshkalonites, the Gittites, and the Ekronites, along with the Avites, the Canaanites, the Sidonians, the Amorites, the Giblites, and all Lebanon toward the sunrising.

note.label: Joshua 13: Much Land Yet to Be Possessed
